title: Backlog churn loop (rowflow + allocator + dispatcher)
summary: Non-inference tasks that unblock inference rows are worked first; each unblocked inference row is published (launcher + spec), dry-run on its real lane, then granted by the one allocator. Per-handoff sessions are auto-started in rank order, paused only while waiting on a queued/running row, and wrap up at every task boundary. Do not stop until all non-inference tasks are exhausted and inference rows armed.

stop_reasons.condition: dry run produced no measured unit, bad rc, or (GPU) no VRAM in use
lineage reached ROW_MAX_FAILS failed dry runs
launcher missing or migrated manifest lacks result_path
free disk below the engine floor (FILLER_DISK_FLOOR_GIB, 150 GiB; 20 GiB in a smoke): a WAIT, never a FAIL

stop_reasons.clears_when: owner prepares inputs and publishes a compute row
